description: DBA-only summary of invalid objects, active sessions, storage, and database uptime.
instructions: Use only for database administration and health checks.
source: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_objects WHERE status = 'INVALID') AS invalid_objects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v$session WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_sessions, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(bytes) / POWER(1024, 3), 2) FROM dba_data_files) AS allocated_storage_gb, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(bytes) / POWER(1024, 3), 2) FROM dba_free_space) AS free_storage_gb, (SELECT ROUND((SYSDATE - startup_time) * 24, 2) FROM v$instance) AS uptime_hours FROM dual
